One complete, working example ships in
[`examples/demo-deck/`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck):
a real project you can `cd` into and build yourself. It's built from
base R's built-in `Theoph` dataset, so no external data is needed, and
it ships a pre-generated `OUTPUTS/` (the same figure/metadata sidecar
[quartifyr's `examples/demo-report`](https://github.com/jprybylski/quartifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-report)
produces from that dataset), so it builds immediately after a clone.

## [`demo-deck`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck): a four-slide PK deck

A small PK-style deck built entirely from `design.yaml`/`layouts.yaml`/
`presentation.yaml` -- no manual slide editing. It exercises a real
`{rpfy}:conc-time.png` reportifyr reference (resolved by
`deckifyr.resolvers.ReportifyrResolver` against `OUTPUTS/` and its
metadata sidecar, with a footer built from `standard_footnotes.yaml`), a
`table` element resolved from a CSV into a native, fully-editable
PowerPoint table with its own `table_styles` chrome, a two-zone
`plot-with-note` layout, speaker notes, and `z_index`/`rotation` on a
freeform closing slide.

```bash
uv run deckifyr build examples/demo-deck/presentation.yaml
# -> examples/demo-deck/build/demo-deck.pptx, demo-deck.manifest.json
```

```r
deck_build("examples/demo-deck/presentation.yaml")
```

## Starting your own project

`deckifyr init` scaffolds the smaller, three-file
[`inst/examples/minimal-deck/`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/inst/examples/minimal-deck)
trio instead of `demo-deck` -- a minimal valid project to build on, not
a demo of every feature:

```bash
uv run deckifyr init my-deck
uv run deckifyr validate my-deck/presentation.yaml
uv run deckifyr build my-deck/presentation.yaml
```

```r
initialize_deck_project("my-deck")
deck_validate("my-deck/presentation.yaml")
deck_build("my-deck/presentation.yaml")
```
